items.quote: Now Gaal son of Ebed moved with his clan into Shechem, and its citizens put their confidence in him.
items.contrast: Gaal son of Ebed, not Abimelek.
items.reason: The pronoun “him” directly refers to Gaal, the newly introduced person. The question is clear, but answering it requires only retrieving this explicitly stated fact rather than resolving a substantial relationship or possible misreading.
